content.comment_body: Hello and happy new year! I wanted to ask if it's possible to enter a setpoint value for a PI controller using the function keys on the [product_name] operator device. My greenhouse window system uses PI control to open or close the windows, and I'd like users to be able to input their preferred temperature setpoint for each operation. Thanks in advance!

Happy new year to you as well. There are four ways to do this: 1) Through the [product_name] menu and operator device menu: select 'set param,' choose the PI controller block, and press OK to adjust the setpoint. 2) Show the setpoint parameter in a message display; you can change the setpoint by holding the ESC key for one second. 3) Use the function keys on the [product_name] operator device. Please see: [url] 4) Use a potentiometer or another analog input device: [url]

Thanks for your help! I'll definitely give it a try. I also want to know if it's possible to display the actual temperature value on the operator device, for example, showing readings in Celsius for several locations within the greenhouse. Can I create different pages to present these separate temperature values? Thanks again for your support!

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked how to input setpoints for a PI controller using the function keys on an operator device within a greenhouse automation system. Suggestions covered different methods for entering and modifying parameters, including the device menu, message text, function keys, and analog input options. The user also asked about displaying multiple temperature readings from different locations on separate device pages, indicating a requirement for adaptable and clear presentation of sensor data.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for straightforward and intuitive ways to input setpoints for the PI controller through operator device function keys and expects to view readings from temperature sensors located throughout the greenhouse on different display pages.
